candidate.rationale: Only the qualified baseline is captured; no later EDA history or feedback is available. This joint configuration/action tuple is untried. Retain baseline utilization=40, density=0.55, abc_area=0 and repair_margin=0: the measured baseline has cell_area_um2=161954, setup_slack_ns=0.19292, hold_slack_ns=0.114491 and zero max_slew/max_cap/max_fanout violations at period_ps=10526. Its limited setup margin favors retaining the qualified physical settings for the first action experiment. Enable both proved actions: exact signed 18-bit reduction with 32-bit sign extension targets arithmetic area and capacitance, and request-qualified multiplier operand isolation targets switching outside request acceptance while preserving the registered cycle contract. Isolation adds masking gates and may increase delay, area or transition activity; synthesis may already eliminate redundant reduction bits, so neither benefit is assumed. Optimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geometric_mean(E_DOT64/2.293945631906608e-07,E_GEMM8/1.7792685987008622e-06,E_CONV3/1.1542462882162743e-06), rather than die area or estimated timing. Protected evaluation must report physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, all three energy_j values, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, setup/hold slack, electrical violations, activity/parasitic annotation and wall-time costs. Compare measured qualified Q with baseline 1.0 and threshold 0.98; retain the best qualified result and all failures/costs. These are hypotheses, not candidate measurement results. Energy evidence is limited to Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route gate activity and extracted SPEF, with no SDF/glitch or silicon-energy claim.
